soil.notes: Listed as clay. Very hard base in its natural state; once watered and disced it turns loamy and rutty. Heavy rain turns the loam to mud and ruts cut down to a shiny, grip-free hard base.

layout.notes: Built in a deep valley on a family farm (since 1977); constant elevation change, no flat section. Many turns and even straights are off-camber. Steep hill before the finish.

conditions.dry: Hard base; off-cambers never feel fully planted.
conditions.wet: Mud first, then deep ruts down to a slick hard base; very MXGP-like. Summer rain is the main risk.
conditions.late_day: Long deep ruts form in corners and at bottoms of downhills; after rain the second motos are a different track.
conditions.watering_prep: Watered and disced deep for nationals.
conditions.seasonal: Pro national each June (moved from Memorial Day); also GNCC and DC Vet Homecoming.

rider_reports.says: Analyst: hard base turns loamy and rutty when prepped; rain made long ruts that cut to a shiny slick base. Some riders muscle through muck, others weave ruts - you need both. Make only small setup changes between motos.
Preview: deep long ruts in corners and at hill bottoms; brake less, lean back, keep the front light and upshift rather than braking into ruts; carry corner speed for the uphills.
